title: Northgate Marketplace Seller Programs: Fulfilment and Delivery Schedule
content:
**Schedule of fulfilment and delivery terms.** For Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee, each seller program fixes who ships an item, how quickly it must leave, how long transit may take for the delivery estimate, how shipping is charged and what the delivery itself requires. The six seller programs of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee are Northgate Marketplace Seller-Fulfilled, Northgate Marketplace Pro Seller, Northgate Marketplace Fulfilled by Northgate, Northgate Marketplace Freight Seller, Northgate Marketplace Certified Renewed and Northgate Marketplace International Seller; the columns below carry their names without the Northgate Marketplace prefix.

| Term | Seller-Fulfilled | Pro Seller | Fulfilled by Northgate | Freight Seller | Certified Renewed | International Seller |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Who stores, packs and ships the item | the seller | the seller | Northgate | the seller | the seller | the seller |
| Condition in which items are sold | new | new | new | new | renewed | new |
| Handling time: business days after the order date within which the item must ship | 2 | 1 | 1 | 5 | 2 | 5 |
| Longest transit time in business days used for the maximum estimated delivery date | 7 | 5 | 4 | 14 | 7 | 21 |
| Calendar used for business days | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays |
| Who sets the shipping charge | the seller's rate | the seller's rate | Northgate Ship to Home fee rules | the seller's rate | the seller's rate | the seller's rate |
| Shipment must carry carrier tracking | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Order total in USD at or above which delivery needs a signature | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 750 | 1000 | 1000 |
| Delivery by appointment with the freight carrier | No | No | No | Yes | No | No |
| Calendar days after delivery within which freight damage must be reported (0 where not applicable) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| How import duties are handled | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | included at checkout |

**Reading the schedule.**

- Who sets the shipping charge: either the seller's rate, or Northgate Ship to Home fee rules, meaning the Ship to Home fee rules of Northgate Store and Online Orders apply.
- The signature threshold is an order total: a delivery of an order whose total is at or above the figure shown needs a signature, so on a Freight Seller order a total of exactly 750 needs one and on every other program a total of exactly 1000 needs one.
- A freight-damage figure of 0 means the reporting period does not apply to that program.
- The handling and transit figures together set the maximum estimated delivery date shown at checkout; on the Freight Seller program, for instance, they are 5 and 14 business days.
